create_fuyu_image_processor: create a FuyuImageProcessorPil instance to preprocess images for the Fuyu multimodal model
build_patchify_image: build image patches from a numpy array or torch tensor using the FuyuImageProcessorPil patchify_image method
test_get_num_patches: test the FuyuImageProcessorPil get_num_patches method to calculate patch counts from image dimensions
run_preprocess_with_tokenizer_info: run preprocess_with_tokenizer_info to generate image input ids, patches, and patch indices for variable-sized images
convert_fuyu_batch_feature: convert FuyuBatchFeature data structures to PyTorch tensors and move them to a target device
